title: Supply-Chain Provenance Tracing Applied to Dataset Lineage in Model Cards

original_idea.body:
# Supply-Chain Provenance Tracing Applied to Dataset Lineage in Model Cards

**Problem:** Food and pharma supply chains require traceable provenance back to source; AI dataset provenance is opaque, so governance can't verify training-data legitimacy claims. The gap is unmeasured.

**Direction:** Transfer the supply-chain traceability/chain-of-custody concept. Sample public model cards and dataset cards, attempt to trace each declared training dataset back to a verifiable source, and score 'provenance depth' (how many links can be confirmed before the trail goes cold). Report systematic break points.

**Why it matters:** Quantifies how far current AI data-provenance falls short of supply-chain traceability norms, informing transparency mandates. Public Hugging Face / model-card data only.

**Relevant context:** Supply-chain chain-of-custody/provenance standards; OWASP AIBOM data-lineage fields; arXiv 2511.15763 (identifying the AI supply chain); Hugging Face dataset cards.
